offering_description.value: Avista supplies electricity and natural gas to households, businesses and public institutions in the inland Northwest and supplies electricity in Juneau, Alaska. It generates and buys power, buys natural gas, and delivers energy over its own utility networks. It also sells electricity to wholesale buyers.

primary_services.value: electric transmission and distribution; natural gas distribution

customer_segment.value: B2C: households in its utility service areas; B2B: commercial and industrial energy users, utilities and power marketers; B2G: local governments, public schools and other government facilities

end_markets.value: residential energy; commercial buildings; industrial facilities; public facilities; wholesale power

revenue_model.value: product sales: electricity and natural gas sold to retail customers and electricity sold to wholesale buyers; transaction or usage fees: regulated customer and delivery charges for electric and natural gas service
revenue_model.category: product sales; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: runs power plants and electric and gas networks to supply households, businesses, public agencies and wholesale buyers

geography_served.value: US regional: utility customers in eastern Washington, northern Idaho, parts of Oregon and Juneau, Alaska, power generation also in Montana

specialization.value: related lines: electric generation and delivery, natural gas distribution and wholesale power sales

distribution_channels.value: other: local electric grids and natural gas mains connected to customer premises; direct sales: wholesale power agreements with utilities and other electricity buyers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state utility commissions oversee retail rates and service, FERC regulates wholesale electricity sales and interstate electric transmission

notes: The current scope of Avista’s smaller nonutility operations is uncertain.
